description: Event dashboard for the 'Wikimania 2026' event. The highlighted 'Event organizer' panel reads 'Teams of the organizer are Core Organizing Team, Social Media, Social Media, ...', listing 'Social Media' eleven times — the duplicate team entries reported in the issue.

The FOSSASIA organizer's own 'Teams' settings page, showing the true configuration the dashboard should reflect: exactly three teams — 'Core Organizing Team' (5 members, all events), 'Review team' (2 members, 1 event) and 'Social Media' (2 members, all events). Each should be named once on the dashboard.
